name: code-review
description: Review the current diff, a PR number, branch or path for correctness bugs, with optional fixes. Use for 'review my changes', 'review this PR', 'find bugs in my diff'.

name: simplify
description: Review changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency and cleanup, then apply the fixes. Quality only, not bug hunting.

name: security-review
description: Security review of the pending changes on the current branch: vulnerabilities, injection, auth, secrets.

name: init
description: Initialize a CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation for a new repository.

name: loop
description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval, poll for status, repeat a task every N minutes.

name: schedule
description: Create, update, list or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) on a cron schedule; one-time scheduled runs and reminders.

name: claude-api
description: Reference for the Claude API and Anthropic SDK: model ids, pricing, streaming, tool use, prompt caching, agents, MCP, token counting.

name: update-config
description: Configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json: hooks, permissions, allow commands, environment variables, automated behaviors.

name: keybindings-help
description: Customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings in ~/.claude/keybindings.json.

name: fewer-permission-prompts
description: Scan transcripts for common read-only tool calls and add an allowlist to reduce permission prompts.

name: run
description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working: run, start or screenshot the app.
